balloons.text: It all began in San Jie Class—a warm afternoon of Python code and sketchbooks.
Today, draw your dream partner—then bring them to life with code!
One line of Python at a time, their classroom sketches began to spark.
Nice work! One clean line of Python and your hero comes alive.
Whoa... look at the screen! It actually worked!
Try running your code now—every great coder starts one line at a time!
Whoa, Teacher Cheong—it's actually moving on my screen!
Teacher Onn, why did our sprite stop right at the edge?
Check your indentation—step by step, you've got this!
All seventeen young Guardians and their teachers—gathered beneath Hero Kai's banner in San Jie Class.
Seventeen friends. Seventeen hand-drawn dreams. One unforgettable class.
And behind every young coder stood the teachers and volunteers guiding San Jie Class with heart.
THE FINAL BELL RANG—AND EVERYONE PACKED THEIR SKETCHBOOKS FOR HOME.
I'M FINISHING MY FIRE-ICE PUP DRAWING TONIGHT!
ACT II · ENTERING PYTHONIA — Behold the Four Realms connected by golden code-streams.
NORTH · ALPINE AURORA PEAKS
WEST · SUN-FORGE VALLEY & CRYSTAL GROTTO
EAST · THE FLOATING CLOUD LIBRARY
SOUTH · EMERALD BAMBOO & SAKURA SANCTUARY
FOUR DISTINCT REALMS—YET ONE LIVING UNIVERSE BOUND BY SHARED KINDNESS AND CODE.
FROM THE EMERALD LOTUS FOUNTAIN, FOUR GOLDEN STREAMS OF LIVING CODE FLOWED OUT TO SUSTAIN ALL FOUR REALMS.
When one stream dims, all four feel the ache—when one blooms, the whole universe heals.
At the Starlight Library, four ancient Realm-Stones pulsed in tune with every kind deed.
Love Earth, Love Others, and Love Self—three virtues weaving Frost, Forge, Forest, and Stars into one.
REALM I · FROST & SKY — Where crisp aurora winds carry clean signals across snowy peaks.
May the northern aurora always guide gentle hearts home.
REALM I · FROST-SKY PEAKS — Home to #01 Ng Shuang, #04 Ong Yu Chen, #10 Tan Eg Siu & #17 Uvincc Long.
REALM II · FORGE & TIDE — Where warm hearth-fire and living crystal waterfalls shape bold ideas.
Listen closely—every flowing river remembers the truth.
REALM II · GOLDEN FORGE CANYON — Home to #02 Lim Dao Yang, #03 Carlzen Lim, #06 Ooi Yu Bhor & #11 Ooi Kai Xiang.
REALM III · VERDANT SANCTUARY — Where emerald bamboo and blossoms shelter quiet patience.
True wisdom reflects the kindness you give to the forest.
REALM III · VERDANT BAMBOO GROVE — Home to #05 Kua Jun Ming, #07 Boey Yi Ren, #13 Lee Ming Hui & #14 Lee Qiu Rong.
REALM IV · CELESTIAL ARCHIVE — Where starlight threads weave every memory into constellations.
Every young coder's dream shines as a star in our archive.
REALM IV · CELESTIAL OBSERVATORY — Home to #08 Lee Khang Kok, #09 Gisele Khoo, #12 Chong Jing Cheng, #15 Cheah Hao Fung & #16 Chan Shi Ye.
Together, we keep the Four Realms shining as one!
For centuries, Elder Lumina and the four Realm Guardians kept that sacred oath.
At Loom Forest Cottage, Grandma Looma rested with a fever—so String stayed loyally by her side.
Take good care of Grandma Looma, String. I'll be back soon!
Arf! Ruff! (Safe with me!)
Guard the cottage door, String! Ember—ready to patrol the sky?
Far beyond the clouds lay Pythonia—a world powered by kindness and code.
What a peaceful morning, Ember! Let's check the border towers!
A broken core... still pulsing with dark code...
Yet in the shadowed ruins, a lonely coder named Vex found something forbidden.
Everyone else had a team. Everyone else had a partner...
Nobody ever invited me inside.
DEEP IN THE MOSSY RUINS, VEX FOUND A CRACKED DARK CORE PULSING WITH FORBIDDEN STATIC.
IF NO ONE WILL CODE WITH ME... I'LL BUILD MY OWN POWER!
A Silver Backdoor Key... one line of override code to unlock it all.

code_tray.output: WARNING: Ancient Bug King Seal unlocked!

balloons.text: If this world won't give me a partner—I'll code my own!

code_tray.output: CRITICAL ERROR: Firewall breached — Bug King awakening!

balloons.text: Wait—it's too strong!! I can't stop it!
Free at last! Let the Great Crash begin!
Your Silver Key opened my cage—now the Four Streams belong to ME!
No—stay back!!
Dark Glitch waves surged through all four golden streams—trapping the four Realm Guardians in shadow!
Ember, look! Seventeen shooting stars—the Ancient Summoning!
To answer the darkness, Pythonia called seventeen new Guardians.
Far across the night, while seventeen students slept...
...their sketchbooks glowed in answer to the seventeen stars.
IN NG SHUANG'S PENANG BEDROOM, HER SKETCHBOOK BLOOMED INTO A RADIANT LOTUS-CODE PORTAL!
MY DRAWING IS GLOWING!
Ribbons of starlight swirled from the open pages straight out into the night sky!
A glowing emerald Lotus-Code Vortex opened straight out of Ng Shuang's sketchbook!
Whoa—my sketchbook is pulling us into Pythonia!!
We're really flying through starlight code!!
Dao Yang! Carlzen! Jun Ming! Hang onto your sketchbooks!!
Guided by warm lotus petals, all seventeen classmates crossed the Starlight Bridge together.
Whoa!! We're flying through starlight!
My compass is spinning like crazy!
Glowing lotus petals cushioned every student's landing across Pythonia Meadow.
We made it—Khang Kok, Gisele, Jing Cheng, Shi Ye! Wait... what's that purple storm?
Welcome to Pythonia! I'm Kai—and this is Ember!
No way!! That's a real dragon!!
All seventeen Guardians are safe! Welcome home to Pythonia!
We're really here—all of us together!
The prophecy was true—all seventeen have arrived!
Wait... are all our classmates here too?!
Everyone! We made it down safe!
Look up—the dragon's escorting us!
This village looks just like our storybook!
Follow the lantern light, young Spellcasters!
Wait—even our gear matches what we sketched!
That's all seventeen! Come see what's waiting in the glade!
Your sketches answered the Four Realms' call. Now meet the partners waiting for you!
As twilight fell, Kai led them into the Moonlit Egg Glade.
Look—seventeen ancient eggs, glowing just for your class!
It's warm... like a little heartbeat inside!
Mine has the exact star from my compass!
Their partners are waking, Kai. Guard them well—darkness already feels their light.
I won't let anything happen to them, Elder!
BENEATH SEVENTEEN ANSWERING STARS, ELDER LUMINA RAISED THE GOLDEN LOTUS LANTERN.
SEVENTEEN GENTLE HEARTS HAVE ARRIVED, KAI. GUIDE THEM WITH WISDOM!
Oh! You're so tiny and warm... hello, Tempest Stag!
It hatched! He's got little cloud ears!
They already know us by heart...
Haha! Hey, that tickles!
Aww—my Ignis-Frost Pup is so warm and cozy!
And Dan just sparked right out of his shell!
Haha, look at Sticky's glowing little drop!
And OKX is wearing little glasses just like my sketch!
Poppy smells just like cherry blossoms!
Hi there, little Sylvan-Fox and Miku!
No way—Bro's actually real!
Berrie and Mimik-Spark are right here with us!
Wait—Emerald-X actually booted up?!
And my Star-Yarn Caticorn is so fluffy!
Berrie's ribbon is glowing—she smells like sweet strawberries!
And Poppy's tail sparkles like a tiny star!
My Star-Yarn Caticorn is so soft and warm!
Haha! Emerald-X sprouted a tiny green leaf!
Each of you receives a Python Spellbook—your code channels your partner's power!
It's just like the Python we learned in class!

code_tray.output: 17 Python Spellbooks synced with Stage-1 Partners!

balloons.text: To new friendships and protecting our living universe—cheers!
Around warm herbal tea, steamed buns, and fresh fruit, seventeen hearts beat as one.
Eat up, everyone—fresh steamed buns and forest berries!
Wait... why did the sky just turn purple?!
Without warning, a jagged purple storm rift tore straight across the meadow sky!
Seventeen new variables?! Swarm them—corrupt every last one!
DARK PURPLE GLITCH MITES CRACKLED THROUGH THE STORM CLOUDS TOWARD THE MEADOW!
SWARM THE MEADOW, MY GLITCH MITES! SCRAMBLE EVERY SPELL!
Whoa!! Brute force only makes the Glitch Mites multiply!
Raw force won't work—we need clean Python logic and calm hearts!

code_tray.output: WARNING: Swarm doubled -> Switch to calm Lotus-Code shield!

balloons.text: Hero Kai and Ember made it just in time!!
Hold steady, Ng Shuang and Uvincc! Lotus-Code Aegis—ACTIVATE!
LOTUS-CODE AEGIS! KINDNESS DEFLECTS THE STATIC!
THE SWARM BOUNCED HARMLESSLY OFF THE CALM LOTUS BARRIER IN SHOWERS OF GOLDEN SPARKS!
Seventeen little bugs... time to crash your code!
IN THE SWIRLING PURPLE MIST, VEX AND LORD MALCODE STOOD BACK-TO-BACK.
WAIT... WHY DO THEY PROTECT EACH OTHER INSTEAD OF RUNNING?
Stay behind us! Ember—ready to fly!
Kai, look out! Someone's with him!
Spellbook Barrier—HOLD! Ember, cover the flank!!
You never needed me, Pythonia... now watch your precious code unravel!
Hold hands! Don't let go!!
Kai!! The wind's pulling us apart!!

code_tray.output: ALERT: Guardians scattered across 4 Pythonia biomes!

balloons.text: Hang onto your partners, guys!
Wait—the Elder's shield is cushioning our fall!
May my lantern carry every child safely to the realm that needs them most!
Four emerald bubbles of light carried the squads across the storm.
Stay together! We'll find Kai and the others!
Keep your Spellbooks close—we're landing on those islands!
IN REALM I: FROST & SKY — Yu Chen, Eg Siu & Uvincc raised their glowing Spellbook beacon!
IN REALM II: FORGE & TIDE — Dao Yang, Carlzen, Yu Bhor & Kai Xiang lit the golden canyon beacon!
IN REALM III: VERDANT SANCTUARY — Jun Ming, Yi Ren, Ming Hui & Qiu Rong sent up the emerald beacon!
We've got you! Climb higher, Ember!!
Find your friends—reunite all seventeen!
Look at the horizon! Your classmates' Spellbooks are sending up signals!
Then let's go bring every single one of them home!
And so the seventeen Guardians were scattered across Pythonia...
...their quest to reunite, evolve, and debug the world had only just started.
